serviceFit.description: How closely the business matches what the user sells.
serviceFit.high: The lead type clearly needs or benefits from the user's service.
serviceFit.medium: The lead may benefit, but evidence is partial.
serviceFit.low: The service is weakly related or irrelevant.

digitalGap.description: Evidence of missing or weak digital infrastructure.
digitalGap.high: No website, weak/unclear web presence, missing booking/menu/catalog/contact flow.
digitalGap.medium: Some digital gaps exist but not severe.
digitalGap.low: Strong existing digital presence or no evidence of a gap.

businessQuality.description: Signs that the business is real, active, reputable, and worth contacting.
businessQuality.high: Good rating/reviews, complete profile, active public presence.
businessQuality.medium: Some signs of legitimacy but limited evidence.

contactability.description: How easy it is to reach the business.
contactability.high: Phone, WhatsApp, email, website form, or active social link exists.
contactability.medium: Only one weak contact path exists.

urgency.description: How urgent and obvious the need appears.
urgency.high: The business likely loses customers due to the observed gap.
urgency.medium: The gap matters but urgency is uncertain.

dataQuality.description: How much reliable data is available to judge the lead.
dataQuality.high: Multiple useful fields exist (name, category, location, contact, rating, social).
dataQuality.medium: Enough data for a moderate judgment.
dataQuality.low: Too little data to make a strong call.

scoreBands.GOLD: 85-100: Highly relevant, strong opportunity, high contact priority.
scoreBands.MEDIUM: 45-69: Possible lead, needs review or more data.

hardRules: If serviceFit < 35, final aiFitScore should usually be below 55.
If dataQuality < 35, confidence cannot be high.
If contactability < 25, contactPriority cannot be URGENT.
If there is no evidence of a digital gap, digitalGap must not be scored high.
If the user service and business type do not match, shouldContact should usually be false.
Do not give GOLD unless at least four dimensions are strong (>= 70).
Do not give high confidence with sparse data (fewer than 4 useful fields).
If shouldContact is false, aiOpportunityScore should normally be below 60.
